notes.title: New name, new look
notes.content:
[h2]New name, new look [/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622518/4bc6beff3f8ed24e24bf53812dfcfc3beb72469d.png"][/img][/h2][p]
Hey all👋 Long story short Mail it to the king is now [b]The You Quiz[/b]! [/p][p]We felt the old name didn't reflect what the game was really about, so we changed it ahead of our upcoming demo release. We're super excited about these changes and we feel the game has never looked so good! 
[/p][p]We also revamped the characters to be more colorful and expressive! Which means that we sadly had to retire our old ones, so we say goodbye to the granny, dog and cloud 😢 [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622518/c91e4f9f54d51c14ba21be5725a1e591bfd38c2e.png"][/img][/p][h2]What is coming next[/h2][p]We're getting very close to demo release and we're super excited for you to try it out and tell us what you think. In the meantime you can already play an early version of the demo by registering for the playtest, it will help us iron out bugs in the demo before public release, and you get a glimpse of the development of the game. [/p][p][/p][h2]Wishlist our game today! 👇[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669740/The_You_Quiz/#game_area_purchase"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: A demo is coming for august!
notes.content:
[h2]👋Hello everyone, how's your summer going?🏖️☀️[/h2][p]Ours is spent working hard on a demo build!🥵
